m: कर्वट (m., L.) n. declivity of a mountain, L.
a village, market-town, the capital of a district (of two or four hundred villages, W.; cf. कावट), Yājñ. ii, 167; Hcat. &c.

a: कर्वटः — 1 The market-town or capital of a district (of two hundred villages). --2 Declivity of a mountain; (also कर्वटक in this sense). --टं A city.
